purpose: Bounded reviewer-contract repair after canonical Qwen3-8B exact-head review run 34541333229 completed all 11 remote inference requests successfully but failed closed during canonical validation because the model returned a schema-valid yet semantically contradictory verdict/findings/summary tuple. Remove redundant model-authored verdict/summary fields so the independent semantic signal is only the bounded findings array and canonical verdict is deterministically derived from its emptiness.

requiredChange.summary: Make the strict model response contract contain exactly one semantic field, findings. findings=[] means no concrete introduced defect; findings=[one finding] means one concrete introduced defect. The trusted validator must validate that exact structure and derive the existing canonical verdict/summary fields from findings without dropping or rewriting any finding.

requiredInvariants: The model's complete semantic decision is preserved: zero findings derives canonical PASS and one finding derives canonical BLOCK; no finding may be filtered, suppressed, downgraded or mechanically converted to PASS.
The strict JSON schema must require exactly the findings key, maxItems=1, the existing bounded finding object, and additionalProperties=false.

The trusted prompt must explicitly instruct the model to return findings=[] only when no concrete introduced defect is directly demonstrated and otherwise return exactly one highest-priority concrete finding.

The canonical published attestation format remains unchanged: verdict PASS/BLOCK, findings count, response hash, exact head, exact diff, manifest, prompt bundle, model/runtime/policy identity and workflow run remain bound exactly as before.
